## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Biotech XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) and Industrials XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%) confirm pockets of risk appetite while SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%) keep the market stance balanced.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Credit stability: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.14%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +1.04%) → neutral-to-positive for risk. Fear easing signaled by VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -9.32%) ↓ falling, offset by commodity weakness: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%) ↓ falling.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Bonds favored: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +3.05%) ↑ rising, implying slightly easier conditions. Dollar and yield-curve signals are NEUTRAL → flat, keeping financial conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Cyclicals and momentum leading: XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +9.72%), XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%). Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%) and Financials in CORRECTION XLF (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +3.45%).

**5. US vs Global?**  
US internals mixed: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -1.92%) while small caps IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +3.14%) show leadership. EM/China weak: EEM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.88% | 1M: -0.13%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Speculation uneven: Momentum MTUM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.36% | 1M: +8.16%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +3.14%) show risk-on pockets, while crypto IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -22.03%) and ETHA BELOW TREND (1W: -10.18% | 1M: -24.84%) signal reduced speculative risk.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Metals and oil weak: GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%) and CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%) ↓ falling. Natural gas strength: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%) ↑ rising.

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Energy mixed-to-weak: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -5.83%) and Brent BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -21.13%) ↓ falling, while nat gas UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%) shows idiosyncratic strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Multiple cyclicals/industrials (XBI, SOXX, XLI) ABOVE TREND align with 7/11 breadth. DIVERGENCE: Minor cross-market mismatches—XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +3.45%), ITA CORRECTION (1W: -2.23% | 1M: +3.51%)—keep the overall read neutral.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals and momentum exposure given XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +9.72%), and reduce exposure to commodity and China exposure such as GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: XBI ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +13.79%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.25% | 1M: +9.72%), XLI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +5.89%).  
BEARISH: KWEB BELOW TREND (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -13.32%), FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -10.72%), GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -10.76%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.70%).  
BEARISH: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -5.25%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -21.13%), SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -13.61% | 1M: -24.90%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
Watch VXX 20 as a complacency threshold — VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.23% | 1M: -9.32%). Monitor HYG/LQD for credit health — HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.14%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.67% | 1M: +1.04%). Track XLK vs XLF pivot around prior range as the style decision point — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.19%) and XLF in CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +3.45%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with pockets of strength offset by tech and China weakness. Industrials and momentum (XLI, XBI, SOXX) showing relative strength. Key risk: commodity/China sell-off and XLF/ITA divergences that could reintroduce rotational volatility.
